desktop_task_manage.description: Create or inspect project-bound Task Rooms and record progress, blockers or a final review. Use mission tools for cross-context mission assignments. Each action controls which fields it accepts.

parameters.action: Operation selected from this tool's enumerated actions. Required inputs depend on the selected action.
parameters.completion_conditions: Conditions used to decide when the task is complete.
parameters.confirm_label: Exact context label required to confirm reattachment.
parameters.context_handle: Private capability of the Task Room context. Keep it out of task text and logs.
parameters.context_id: Public identifier of the Task Room context.
parameters.context_label: Operator-visible label for this Task Room context.
parameters.current_step_id: Identifier of the step currently in progress.
parameters.device: Device label associated with this Task Room context.
parameters.limit: Maximum records to return in this list.
parameters.missing_checks: Checks still outstanding at the time of the report.
parameters.open_risks: Outstanding risks to retain in the task record.
parameters.project: Project label associated with this task.
parameters.review_status: Outcome of the task's final review.
parameters.step_id: Identifier of the step being updated.
parameters.step_status: New state of the selected step.
parameters.steps: Steps to record for this task, in execution order.
parameters.summary: Short account of the progress or result being recorded.
parameters.task_id: Identifier of the project-bound Task Room.
parameters.task_status: Task state recorded by this operation.
parameters.title: Short title shown in the Task Room.
parameters.verified_facts: Facts already supported by evidence for this task.

desktop_skill_manage.description: Inspect documentary skill versions and read their resources, or install, activate and roll back a version when permitted by the operator.

parameters.action: Operation selected from this tool's enumerated actions. Required inputs depend on the selected action.
parameters.activate: Whether to make the selected skill version active after installation.
parameters.expected_sha256: Expected SHA-256 digest of the selected skill content.
parameters.max_chars: Character limit for returned skill text.
parameters.name: Name of the documentary skill to inspect or manage.
parameters.resource_path: Path of the requested resource within the skill.
parameters.source_path: Local source path for the requested skill package.
parameters.source_url: URL of the requested skill source, subject to the configured source policy.
parameters.version: Exact skill version to inspect or select.

parameters.action: Operation selected from this tool's enumerated actions. Required inputs depend on the selected action.
parameters.name: Name of the configured extension server.
parameters.description: Operator-facing description of the proposed extension.
parameters.enabled: Requested enablement state for this extension.
parameters.oauth: OAuth configuration selected for the extension.
parameters.oauth_scope: OAuth scope requested from the upstream provider.
parameters.oauth_client_auth_method: Registered method of authenticating this OAuth client.
parameters.oauth_client_secret_env: Environment variable name containing the upstream client secret. Supply the name only.
parameters.force: Whether to force the requested extension refresh when supported.

desktop_mcp_tool_inspect.description: Read one approved extension tool’s cached descriptor and input contract. Use desktop_mcp_tool_search when its name is unknown.

parameters.name: Registered name of the approved extension tool whose descriptor is needed.

parameters.query: Search terms matched against cached extension descriptors.
parameters.server: Limit the search to this configured extension server.
parameters.limit: Maximum records to return in this list.

desktop_mcp_tool_call.description: Invoke one approved extension operation using its published argument schema. Review the cached descriptor first. Effects and returned content depend on that extension.

parameters.name: Registered name of the approved extension operation.
parameters.arguments: Arguments matching the approved extension tool's input schema.

desktop_policy_status.description: Read the workstation file provider’s effective policy and limits. Use agent_bridge_status for the gateway, profile and total tool count.

parameters.depth: Number of directory levels to traverse. Use 1 for immediate children.

parameters.offset: Zero-based line index. A negative offset counts from the end of the file.
parameters.length: Maximum number of text lines to return.

parameters.pattern: Expression to match against a filename or a line of text. Interpreted as a regex unless literal_search is true.
parameters.search_type: Match filenames with files, or text lines with content when the active profile permits it.
parameters.file_pattern: Optional filename glob restricting the files examined.
parameters.ignore_case: Match regardless of letter case when true.
parameters.include_hidden: Include hidden entries only when supported by the workspace policy.
parameters.literal_search: Treat pattern as literal text instead of a regular expression.
parameters.max_results: Stop collecting after this many matches.
parameters.timeout_ms: Search time budget in milliseconds; a partial result can be truncated.

parameters.action: Operation to perform. Supply path for publish and artifact_id for get, read or delete; list accepts an optional limit.
parameters.artifact_id: Instance-local ID from publish or list. Required for get, read and delete.
parameters.encoding: Representation of a read chunk: utf8 for text or base64 for arbitrary bytes.
parameters.length: Maximum bytes to read in this chunk. Used only with read.
parameters.limit: Maximum number of artifacts to return for list.
parameters.offset: Zero-based byte offset for read. Use next_offset from the preceding chunk.
parameters.retention_seconds: Lifetime of the stored copy from publication, in seconds. Used only with publish.

parameters.content: UTF-8 text for the selected write operation.
parameters.mode: Choose whether to rewrite or append the supplied text.
parameters.observation_id: One-use observation from a recent read of this file by the same provider.

parameters.old_string: Exact existing text to replace in the observed file.
parameters.new_string: Replacement text for the matched existing text.
parameters.expected_replacements: Number of exact matches the edit expects before it changes the file.
parameters.observation_id: One-use observation from a recent read of this file by the same provider.

parameters.source_observation_id: One-use observation from a recent read of the source file by the same provider.

parameters.actor_context_handle: Private handle of the destination mission context.
parameters.context_id: Public identifier of the Task Room context.
parameters.context_handle: Private capability of the Task Room context. Keep it out of task text and logs.
parameters.task_id: Identifier of the project-bound Task Room.

parameters.lease_id: Opaque identifier of an existing virtual desktop lease.

parameters.context_handle: Private capability of the Task Room context. Keep it out of task text and logs.

agent_bridge_status.description: Inspect the workstation version, selected tool count, capability identity, active profile and component qualification. Use desktop_policy_status for filesystem limits.

agent_bridge_mission_get.description: Read one mission's goal, status, revision and timestamps as an attached member. Use mission_observe to check an invitation or identify the current owner; it also works before attachment.

parameters.actor_context_handle: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.
parameters.mission_id: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

agent_bridge_mission_observe.description: Check your invitation or membership before a handoff. Returns the mission revision, current owner's public ID, your role and attachment state. For the goal and work status, attached members can use mission_get.

parameters.actor_context_handle: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.
parameters.mission_id: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

agent_bridge_mission_checkpoint.description: Append one durable progress summary to a mission you have joined. This advances the mission revision and returns the updated mission record. For history, or to check whether a write succeeded before retrying, use the plural mission_checkpoints tool.

parameters.actor_context_handle: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.
parameters.mission_id: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.
parameters.summary: Progress or result to record for this mission.
parameters.if_revision: Current mission revision from mission_observe. A stale revision is rejected.

agent_bridge_mission_checkpoints.description: Read saved result summaries for a mission you have joined, newest revision first. Returns checkpoint IDs, summaries and revisions, including an empty list when none exist. To append a summary, use the singular mission_checkpoint tool.

parameters.actor_context_handle: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.
parameters.mission_id: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.
parameters.limit: Maximum number of records to return; defaults to 20.
